question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is **"Vaccuum."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is **"Vacuum."** • The word refers to a space that is completely empty of matter. (एक ऐसा स्थान जो पदार्थ से पूरी तरह खाली है) • **Example**: *There can't be a moral **vacuum**__ at the heart of this.* • The word is often used in the context of cleaning or removing debris. • The word is derived from the Latin word **"vacuus," meaning "empty."** • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Domicile (Option 1)**: refers to a person's legal residence or home. ((क़ानून में) अधिवास, निवास स्‍थान) • **Trendy (Option 2)**: refers to something that is fashionable or popular at the moment. (फै़शनेबल) • **Vacillate (Option 3)**: refers to wavering between two choices or opinions. ((विचार या मत में) टुलमुल होना, डाँवाँडोल होना, प्रायः खीजते हुए आगा-पीछा करना) 3d:Tf87, The correct answer is **"hurricane."**
